=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A log PR closed without merging is handled like a merged one, so restarting the working branch from the default branch drops the closed branch's unmerged log commits. The same text is in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (line 66 per minimax_minimax-m3).
  WHY: Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (rare, bounded cost) and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR (confirmed [x] steps may be lost, and a re-run can duplicate side effects). The ledger uses the highest, which is MAJOR, shown here as high.
- changelog.d/9675-deploy-activate-one-log-pr-per-session.md:9-11 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The row "Log PRs per `/deploy-activate` session after this change | 1" says one log PR per session. The command text opens a new draft PR when the first merges or closes mid-session.
  WHY: This is changelog drift with no runtime effect, but an operator could read the second PR as a defect.
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The earlier-session log PR is identified by title, branch and file scope, with no author check. The same text is in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md. Both reviewers raised this as a hardening suggestion, and minimax_minimax-m3 gave it HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 3.
  WHY: An outside actor with write access could match the title and file scope. The merge only goes into the session's own working branch, which opens a PR that is reviewed before it merges.
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The phrase "ID records" suggests a constrained subset, but the parenthetical allows the whole agents file or any `agents.d/` entry. Any agents-file change therefore passes the file-scope check. This was a hardening suggestion with HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 3.
  WHY: The wording and the check do not match, so the session cannot tell which agents-file lines count as ID records.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Changelog and PR description promise "one log PR per session" (table row "Log PRs per `/deploy-activate` session after this change | 1")
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/9675-deploy-activate-one-log-pr-per-session.md table row, and/or .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:66
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The command text says "open one new draft PR for the updates that remain" when the first log PR merges or closes mid-session. A session can therefore produce two log PRs, which contradicts the "1" in the table row.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md ("One log PR per session" bullet, earlier-session PR clause; same text in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The earlier-session PR is identified by title, open state, branch name and changed-file scope. There is no author check.
  WHY: The PR author does not matter to the session. The session only merges that branch into its own working branch, which opens a PR that is reviewed before it merges. This is hardening only.
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md ("If it has merged or been closed in the meantime, do not commit onto its branch: restart the working branch from the latest default branch under the same name (CLAUDE.md §21.A)"; same text in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A log PR closed without merging is handled like a merged one. The restart drops the closed branch's unmerged log commits.
  WHY: The session still holds the confirmed steps in its own context. Closing a log PR mid-session is deliberate and rare, so the cost is bounded. This is a minor wording gap.
- changelog.d/9675-deploy-activate-one-log-pr-per-session.md (table row "Log PRs per `/deploy-activate` session after this change | 1") | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The row says exactly one log PR per session, but the command text opens one new draft PR when the first merges or closes mid-session.
  WHY: This is changelog drift with no runtime effect. Changing "1" to "1 (one more only if the first merges or closes mid-session)" would fix it.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: In both command copies, add "authored by the same GitHub login as the session" to the earlier-session PR clause, and mirror it in the test's required strings (2 lines per file, 1 in the test). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 (same defect in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md around line 66) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The recovery path treats a closed-without-merging log PR the same as a merged one. A merged PR's log is already on the default branch, but a closed PR's is not, so restarting from default drops its log commits, including steps already marked [x].
  WHY: The next session sees no [x] marks for the confirmed steps and may re-run them. A re-run of a step with a side effect (a flag flip, a deploy) can duplicate state or diverge from the original evidence.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description and changelog promise "one log PR per session" (changelog.d/9675-deploy-activate-one-log-pr-per-session.md:9-11, row "Log PRs per `/deploy-activate` session after this change | 1")
  Expected change site: changelog.d/9675-deploy-activate-one-log-pr-per-session.md table row, and/or .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:59 and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:66
  Evidence of absence: The command text says "open one new draft PR for the updates that remain" when the first log PR merges or closes mid-session, so a session can produce two log PRs. That contradicts the "1" in the table.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items):
  - Add a PR-author check, with the PR author login equal to the session's own login, in both command copies (around line 59 / template line 66). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
  - Split the merged and closed-without-merging recovery cases: restart from default if merged. If closed without merging, fetch the closed head branch into a scratch ref and copy any [x] marks into the current log. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5
  - Tighten the "ID records" wording to match the parenthetical, so the file-scope check is "every changed file is under `docs/deploy-activation/`, is the agents file, or is in `agents.d/`". HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
(No findings reported.)
